services.name: Coho Salmon Half Day Fishing
services.desc: 6-7 hours About Treat yourself to a Coho Salmon fishing charter trip originating at our slip between the Embarcadero Resort and The Landing which is located on the beautiful Yaquina Bay in Newport Oregon. The half day salmon trip is about 6 to 7 hours in length. We fish no more than 12 people on our boats to ensure plenty of room. Private charters are available. Our experienced and friendly staff will be on board to help as much or as little as you need. Crabbing can be added to this trip for $20 extra per person. Please no children under 6 years old. We’ll take you to some of the Ages 6+ • 6-7 hours • Up to 12 people

services.name: Half Day Near Shore Rock Fish & Lingcod
services.desc: 5 hours About Go bottom fish off the coast of Newport, Oregon! Every fish has it’s flavor-able characteristic and Oregon’s bottom fish are no exception. Some also call it Rock Fishing. This trip is near shore and uses light tackle. This is a great trip for anyone new to fishing and for those who have fished their whole lives. With Yaquina Bay Charters, we’ll take you to some of the best near shore reefs where you’ll find a variety of fish including Sea Bass, Sea Trout, Cabazon and the much sought after Ling Cod. If you want to really round it off, add Dungeness crabbing to your trip. Ages 6+ recommended • 5 hours

services.name: Pacific Halibut Offshore Fishing Trip
services.desc: 12 hours About Yaquina Bay Charters offers Offshore Halibut charters for 12 hours dock to dock, or until limits are taken. These trips are about 20 to 30 miles off shore in deep water. The Crackerjack, Gracie K, Miss Raven, and Umatilla II are 43-50 feet long and will accommodate up to 12 fisherman each comfortably. The Spindrift is a 37 foot Delta and accommodates up to 10 anglers comfortably. Each person fishing will receive their own pole. No one has to share a fishing rod. Everyone gets to fish all the time, no taking turns. Go by yourself, with friends or with family. Private 12 hours • Ages 12+ recommended • Includes Ocean Crabbing!

services.name: Full Day Off Shore Rock Fish & Lingcod
services.desc: 8 hours About Go bottom fish off the coast of Newport, Oregon! This trip is off shore where we tend to see the large Ling Cod. With Yaquina Bay Charters, we’ll take you to some of the offshore reefs where you’ll find Sea Bass, Yellow Tail rockfish, Canary rockfish, Widow rockfish, Cabazon, Kelp Greenling, and the much sought after Ling Cod. If you want to really round it off, add Dungeness crabbing to your trip. Limits on bottom fish change so check out the latest news and fishing blogs for the latest limits. Bottom fish are great for fish and chips, sautéed or added to a Ciopinno. Ages 6+ • 8 Hours

services.name: Ocean Crabbing
services.desc: Around 2 hours About Take a trip with us for an exciting time crab fishing! You will head out into the ocean to pick up crab pots that have been soaking since morning, sort your catch, and then head back to port with your bounty. Crab cleaning and cooking is available for a small fee. These trips are about 1.5-2 hours and can accommodate up to 14 people. Available March through Oct. 15, a minimum of 6 people is required to go out. Departure times are in the afternoon. Please no children under 6 years Ages 6+ • Around 2 hours • Up to 14 people

services.name: Full Day Off Shore Rock Fish Long Leader
services.desc: 8 hours About Enjoy a full day trip in the offshore rockfish grounds. It's been a long time since we were able to fish out here and as a result fishing is very good. The best part is the limit for these trips is 10 rockfish per person! You will see a variety of fish on this trip. Yellow Tail, Widow Rock Fish, Canary, Bocaccio and Silver Grey's are just some of the rock fish you will be able to keep. We are using heavier gear with 3 hooks and 30 feet of long leader with a lead attached at the bottom. We are fishing in mid to deep water. The water depth is 200-600 Ages 6+ • Up to 12 people on the boat

services.name: Coho Salmon / Rockfish Combo Fishing Trip
services.desc: 10 hours About Treat yourself to a Coho Salmon fishing charter trip originating at our slip between the Embarcadero Resort and The Landing which is located on the beautiful Yaquina Bay in Newport Oregon. We’ll take you to some of the best known places to catch a Coho Salmon such as the ‘ Rock Pile’ which is 11 miles off of South Beach. We’ll also go to some serious salmon run locations which are continuously watched and reported on by our charter boats. This trip will split your time between fishing for salmon and rockfish. quotes.author: Betsy M. - Google
quotes.text: Yaquina Bay Charters had the friendliest crew of any boat company I have used! Not only did the crew make the day enjoyable, but everyone on the boat caught their limits of rockfish. Along with lingcod and crab, we now have enough seafood to feed us for our week’s vacation. I absolutely will use this company for future fishing trips.

quotes.author: Charlie K - Tripadvisor
quotes.text: Great trip with my sons and son-in-law on the "Crackerjack" with Captain Jack and First Mate Dylan. Caught our Rockfish limit within 1 1/2 hours of leaving the dock. Had to throw several more back after we switched to lingcod. Added on a couple of lingcod for a very nice day of fishing. Helped that it was a very calm day.

quotes.author: Daniel R - Tripadvisor
quotes.text: I booked a half day of bottom fishing and crab for a group of 5. Captain Shannon and Deckhand Shawn on the Gracie K were exceptional hosts. Not only did we find fish almost every group on the boat limited out. It was a great day and great experience for everyone! I will definitely be booking another trip soon!

quotes.author: Tyson C. - Google
quotes.text: Yaquina Bay Charters has always taken care of me when I want to get a line in the water, weather permitting. The staff are friendly and Captain Jerald is knowledgeable and devoted to putting people on the productive fishing grounds.

quotes.author: Bradley - Google
quotes.text: Great experience! Captain and deckhand were great and my whole group (7 people) all limited out on rock fish and caught 2 ling cod to boot. Hard to beat the experience, especially for the price!

quotes.author: Celeste P - Tripadvisor
quotes.text: Everyone gets to fish! Each trip we have limited on fish, captains are amazing and fun plus deckhands are always helpful. One of my favorite charters!
